svg.title: Private-only | Hosted agent architecture
svg.desc: Private invocation, creation-time agent network injection, and a private gateway-to-model route.

g.text: Private invocation, creation-time agent network injection, and a private gateway-to-model route.
Azure PaaS services | Public access disabled for Foundry, gateway and models
Linked zones for Foundry, gateway, models and registry. All endpoint nodes share the endpoints subnet.
Entra ID / Azure Resource Manager / Azure Monitor require their own connectivity.
Network injection does not make all egress or platform-managed agent data private.
Private request path verified in one deployment. ACR public access is unchanged. Authentication details and evidence are in the guide.
